about: The judgment census (t-1765 node A3, AR-29): one row per check unit of scripts/*.py outside scripts/tests/ - what it judges (class), on whose path it stands (roles), whom it serves (owner). Read by scripts/tests/test_judgment_census.py and by tools/architecture_gate.py (the `ratchet` object); not read by any project (axis 18). `blocks` is computed by the test, never written here; `blocks_override: false` (with a `note`) is the only hand mark. Classes: shape, xref, word-list, meaning-proxy, meaning, safety; owner: data, judgment, intent. Ceilings only go down. Blind spot: a subclass of `ValueError` or `StateConflict` raised by its own name is invisible to `refusal_registry.sites` (it matches the literal names); legitimate when the subclass is caught and never reaches a role, but a subclass chosen to keep a ratchet down is not seen - the critic's question 11 and calibration check 41 catch it.

rows.note: X7-5, P28: `red_test {path, command}` or `red_test_none: <why>` is present on a bug draft / bug - presence only

shape + xref (t-2277 FL-2, J-C3): the words of the first-look record against the closed lists, one row per requirement of the register and none outside it, each cited capture tied to this walk's attempt of that requirement by walk_session.capture_cited - keys and joins only, never whether a row is true
advice only: writes `suggested[]`, never the field
puts one row question to the judge and returns the answer; it can only AVOID a refusal. The refusal of a blank field is the caller's: `handoff_check.py::check` (word-list)
asks the judge whether a finding is a tooling cause and returns the answer; refuses nothing itself. Its caller is `handoff_check.py::check_findings` (shape)
X7-5: a row `blocked` beside an empty `blocked.problem` - the value of a state field against the presence of a field; `handoff.is_placeholder` is `^<.+>$` or empty, no dictionary of placeholder words

X7-5: empty field, max_len, a value outside the list; the list is CLOSED only on route fields (code branches on the word, E-16) - every other list field of an S5-S9 form takes `new: <word> -- <why>` (OPEN_LIST_FIELDS). The judge's nearest word is advice (`_ask_judge`). F4 (the rows-owed block): counts rows of a section the contract owes under a verdict word (`handoff.rows_owed`); never reads what a finding says
prints ADVICE only (X7-2): copies of existing code go to the code critic; nothing here refuses
prints ADVICE only (X7-2): parametrisation candidates go to the code critic; nothing here refuses
prints ADVICE only (X7-2): a relative oracle on an unasserted base goes to the code critic; nothing here refuses

t-2181 PC-4 C1-C6: shape + xref of tests[].sides, then_bindings[].about, provisional[] and pending_implementation rows against the sides reader and the run blocks (xref, the higher); no judgment of a placeholder, a Then or a run
prints ADVICE only (X7-2): the smells go to the code critic in an `ADVICE` block and `work/advice-S5.json`; nothing here refuses

forwards the findings to the judge and DOWNGRADES the ones it says do not apply (it can only lift a refusal, never add one); the refusal is the caller's: `s5_precheck.py::run` (xref), and each `check_*` finding keeps its own row
